scientific_integrity: Base graph-state cut rank credited to Hein et al.; Rule-60 Mersenne kernel to Sfairopoulos et al. and Carmona-Pírez et al. New claim is the universal two-fault placement law and sharpness.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to ideal qubit graph states on toroidal honeycomb graphs of Mersenne widths >=7, color bipartition, and zero, one or two omitted CZ bonds, with distinct endpoints for two. No noise, other bipartitions, or arbitrary third faults. Independent priority/peer verification not performed.
title: Universal two-bond-loss entanglement gain on Mersenne honeycomb graph-state tori
